note: Port locals' barks (authored, not LLM), read by src/systems/npc/townsfolk.gd. The keys the guard brain asks for (contact, hit, reload, lost, give_up) plus the locals' own alarm, man_down and downed. A line is picked at random per key. Generic, in-world, no franchise terms.

alarm: They're shooting at us! Get them!
Everyone, out! They hit one of ours!
found_body: Oh no. Somebody's dead over here!
give_up: Let them run. We'll remember the face.
Back to it. Keep your eyes open.
downed: Drag them to the pit. Let the Remnant have them.
